_comment: Copy this file to api_keys.json (same folder) and fill in what you use. api_keys.json itself is gitignored and never gets committed — everything below stays local to your machine.
_comment_gemini: Primary voice + reasoning engine. Optional — everything except live voice works without it.
_comment_fallback: Used automatically if Gemini fails or its quota is exhausted, for text-based tools (code_helper, dev_agent, self_maintain, search summaries, etc). Tried in this order: Claude, then Groq, then a custom/local endpoint — configure any/all.
_comment_search: Powers web search / news summaries. DuckDuckGo is always used as the no-key baseline regardless of this setting.
_comment_github: Only needed for self_update's clone mode against a private repo when no interactive git credential prompt is available.
_comment_hotkey: System-wide mute toggle (works even when LITE's window isn't focused). pynput format — see https://pynput.readthedocs.io/en/latest/keyboard.html#global-hotkeys
